images.name: hero-oss-bss-illustration.png
images.prompt:
Generate ONE finished PNG illustration, canvas 1600 x 1200 pixels, 4:3, plain white background. This is ONLY the right-hand illustration that will later be placed into a blog hero template. Do not generate the template, logo, title, website, buttons or other text.
Flat vector illustration, clean modern style, generous white padding, no drop shadows, no gradients. Colors: Spenza orange #FF4500 / #EA580C, charcoal #171717, white, light grey #F3F4F6, mid grey #9CA3AF, pale blue #E8F1F8 and pale orange #FFF1E8. Solid clean fills, consistent charcoal line icons with small orange accents. All labels sans-serif, perfectly legible, spelled verbatim.
Two large rounded panels side by side with a generous gap between them.
LEFT panel pale blue #E8F1F8. Heading "OSS" bold charcoal. Subheading "Network & Service Management". Three small line icons with labels underneath: node graph "Network"; two interlocking gears "Service"; plug "Configuration & Activation". Wrap longer labels neatly. Below icons a row of FOUR chevron steps, pale blue with visible charcoal outlines and charcoal text, left-to-right: "Service Order", "Provisioning", "Activation", "Monitoring/Assurance". All four must fit within left panel, labels may wrap.
RIGHT panel pale orange #FFF1E8. Heading "BSS" bold charcoal. Subheading "Business Support". Three small line icons with labels: clipboard "Order Management"; price tag "Product & Catalog Management"; bar chart "Revenue & Analytics". Wrap longer labels neatly. Below icons a row of THREE chevron steps pale orange with visible charcoal outlines and charcoal text, left-to-right: "Customer Order", "CRM", "Payment".
Between panels IN THE GAP: solid orange #FF4500 arrow pointing LEFT, FROM right-hand BSS TO left-hand OSS, label "Order". Under it mid grey #9CA3AF arrow pointing RIGHT, FROM left-hand OSS TO right-hand BSS, label "Usage". Both arrows stay within the gap and do not overlap labels.
Along bottom spanning both panels, a thin row of three small rounded pills: "Host MNO" grey with charcoal text; "MVNE" charcoal with white text; "MVNO" orange with white text.
No other text. No Spenza logo, carrier logos, people, photos, watermark, title text, Learn more button. Exact spelling and correct arrow direction are highest priority.

images.name: hero-us-mvno-illustration.png
images.prompt:
Generate ONE finished PNG illustration, canvas 1800 x 1200 pixels, 3:2. This is ONLY the right-hand illustration for later insertion into a blog hero template, not the whole template. Plain white outer background. A single self-contained rounded rectangle panel fills most of canvas with even generous white margin on all sides.
Within the panel ONLY: dark charcoal-to-orange vertical gradient, charcoal #171717 at top fading to orange #F97316 at bottom. Faint low-contrast silhouette of the continental United States and a few small glowing orange network nodes connected by thin lines. This gradient and node glow are explicitly allowed; otherwise flat clean vector shapes.
Top-right corner of panel: orange ribbon badge with white bold capitals "GUIDE".
Left side: white SIM card with a gold chip, beside an orange smartphone, both flat clean illustrations, no screen text or app interface.
Right side: THREE stacked rounded layers connected by small vertical arrows, well spaced and fully inside panel.
Top layer orange #FF4500, white text "Your brand".
Middle layer charcoal #171717 with thin white outline, white text "MVNE".
Bottom layer light grey #F3F4F6, charcoal text exactly "US host network: AT&T, T-Mobile or Verizon", with a small cell tower line icon. Wrap bottom label across multiple lines if needed, ensuring all words fully readable.
Along lower edge INSIDE panel: two small white outlined tags labeled "FCC filings" and "Launch timeline".
Only text allowed: "GUIDE", "Your brand", "MVNE", "US host network: AT&T, T-Mobile or Verizon", "FCC filings", "Launch timeline". Clean sans-serif labels spelled exactly.
No Spenza logo, no carrier logos, no FCC seal, no people, no photos, no watermark, no title text, no Learn more button, no website pill, no other text. Colors orange #FF4500 / #EA580C / #F97316, charcoal #171717, white, light grey #F3F4F6, mid grey #9CA3AF, and gold for SIM chip as specified. No drop shadows. Generous padding.
